name: youtube-agent
description: Twelve Claude skills that run a YouTube channel: scripts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, title and thumbnail linted as one pairing, an edit decision list from your transcript, a retention reader that finds the exact moments people leave, a Shorts cutter, chapters, search, comments, the weekly plan, a channel audit, a virality engine that ranks your niche by outlier multiple rather than by channel size, and a producer that runs one video end to end with an independent fact-check and stops before anything is published.
